offence_note: Robbery, sexual assault with weapon, confinement, threats; two complainants; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: I must declare him to be a dangerous offender and sentence him to an indeterminate period of incarceration, and I do so.
note: Two years pre-sentence custody mentioned but no credit stated.

offence_note: Manslaughter of his mother, youth sentence
sentence_quote: In my view, the overall length of the custody and supervision order should be 24 months.
note: Intensive rehabilitative custody and supervision order: 4 months secure custody then community supervision; 737 days pre-sentence detention considered.

offence_note: Armed robbery, discharging firearm with intent, aggravated assault
sentence_quote: I find a global sentence of 11 years less credit for time served is reasonable and appropriate
note: Remorse claimed but court emphasised denunciation; lifetime firearms prohibition.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal is granted but the appeal against sentence is dismissed.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; Crown sentence appeal dismissed; conditional sentence stands.

offence_note: Theft under $5,000 from employer, breach of trust
sentence_quote: In my view, it is not contrary to the public interest and in your own interest that you be discharged on significant conditions prescribed in a probation order made pursuant to s. 731(2).

offence_note: Carrying weapon for dangerous purpose, firearm possession, recognizance breaches
sentence_quote: allow the appeal and substitute a two-year-less-a-day conditional sentence for the two-year-less-a-day custodial sentence
note: Probation and ancillary orders from trial undisturbed; details not shown.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine and fentanyl for trafficking
sentence_quote: He was sentenced on May 30, 2019 to a 16 month custodial sentence which reflected credit of 16 months for time served.
note: Appeal dismissed; ancillary orders not shown.

offence_note: Two aggravated assaults and three counts uttering threats
sentence_quote: He will accordingly be sentenced to a further five years for the two aggravated assaults.
note: Eight years concurrent for assaults, three years concurrent for threats; 10-year weapons prohibition after release.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the sentence appeal is allowed, the sentence imposed by the trial judge is set aside and a sentence of six years imprisonment is substituted.
note: Seven years reduced to six for cooperation with police.
